title: 凯南·小纸鸢
description: 紫衣小忍者凯南坐着给小纸鸢系尾带，飞镖安全收入布袋，眼睛亮亮地看着成品。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Kennen is a small adult yordle ninja with large pointed ears beneath a purple hood, a cloth face mask, bright expressive eyes, and a compact furry silhouette. Preserve his purple martial tunic, fully covering wraps, gloves, and little boots. His familiar throwing star is secured inside a closed cloth equipment pouch, with no lightning strike, flying weapon, or attack posture.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a low veranda step and ties a soft ribbon tail onto a little diamond paper kite. Both small hands remain clearly visible, and the kite rests on his knees rather than flying. A rounded bamboo plant and one warm lantern provide a simple setting, emphasizing patient concentration and a cheerful tilt of the ears.
art_direction.palette: violet purple, warm cream, pale yellow, bamboo green
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
